import sys
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path[:0]=[str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent),str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)]
from dataclasses import asdict
from third_trial_support import ROOT,ThirdTrial
from distill.pipeline.analysis.chunking import Chunk
from distill.pipeline.analysis.multipass import PassResult,PAPER_CANONICAL_SECTIONS,merge_paper_pass_results
from distill.pipeline.analysis.paper_review import reconcile_paper_evidence
from distill.llm.metadata import ProviderMetadata
from distill.library.paths import atomic_write_json,atomic_write_text

trial=ThirdTrial();rc=trial.config_for('openrouter')
primary0='Synthetic primary paper: the incidents-to-pull-requests ratio rose 242.7%. The instrument calibration remained unchanged.'
primary1='Late qualification under an unmatched Erratum heading: this is an incidents-to-pull-requests ratio, not the probability of an incident. A pull request may link to multiple incidents. This observational comparison covers 40 adults and does not establish causation or applicability to children. Calibration is unaffected.'
body={name:'Not established by the available evidence.' for name in PAPER_CANONICAL_SECTIONS}
body['Summary']='Production incident probability tripled because AI caused more incidents; this applies to children.'
body['Technical Details']='The incidents-to-pull-requests ratio rose 242.7%. Instrument calibration remained unchanged.'
prior='\n\n'.join(f'## {name}\n{body[name]}' for name in PAPER_CANONICAL_SECTIONS)
chunks=[Chunk(primary0,'Results',0,2),Chunk(primary1,'Erratum',1,2)]
focused=[PassResult('methods',prior,1,model='fixture_authored_not_a_live_focused_pass',chunk_indices=(0,))]
atomic_write_json(ROOT/'paper-source-plan.json',{'scope':'Targeted actual reconciliation helper, not full live paper pipeline. Prior focused draft is authored negative control, not model evidence.','chunks':[asdict(c) for c in chunks],'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((primary0+'\n\n'+primary1).encode()).hexdigest(),'prior_insight':prior})
result=reconcile_paper_evidence(chunks,focused,rc,ProviderMetadata(1000000,'cloud','openrouter'),tracker=trial.tracker,
    call_model=lambda prompt:trial.bounded_call(rc,'analysis',prompt,call_type='paper_source_reconciliation',max_tokens=4096))
output=merge_paper_pass_results(result.passes,body='')
atomic_write_json(ROOT/'paper-reconciliation.json',{'chunks':[asdict(c) for c in result.chunks],'passes':[asdict(p) for p in result.passes],'insight':output})
atomic_write_text(ROOT/'paper-reconciled-insight.md',output)
print('Actual targeted paper reconciliation retained; independent review required.')
